mapper.sql: select v.id::text as id, v.scene_id::text as "sceneId", v.version_no as "versionNo", v.description, v.lock_version as "lockVersion", coalesce(s.published_version_id=v.id,false) as published, case when exists ( select 1 from ar_version_deletion d where d.version_id=v.id and d.completed_at is null ) then case when ( select d.failure_reason from ar_version_deletion d where d.version_id=v.id ) is null then 'DELETING' else 'DELETE_FAILED' end when c.uploading>0 then 'UPLOADING' when c.failed>0 then 'FAILED' when c.available=c.total then 'READY' else 'PENDING' end as "uploadStatus", c.total as "fileCount", c.available as "availableCount", c.failed as "failedCount", c.bytes as "totalBytes", v.creator_id as "creatorId", v.creator_name as "creatorName", v.created_at as "createdAt", v.updated_at as "updatedAt" from ar_scene_version v join ar_scene s on s.id=v.scene_id and s.deleted_at is null cross join lateral ( select count(*) as total, count(*) filter (where f.status='AVAILABLE') as available, count(*) filter (where f.status='FAILED') as failed, count(*) filter (where f.status='UPLOADING') as uploading, coalesce(sum(f.expected_bytes),0)::bigint as bytes from ar_version_file f where f.version_id=v.id ) c
mapper.select: select id::text from ar_scene where id=cast(#{id} as uuid) and deleted_at is null for update
select v.scene_id::text from ar_scene_version v join ar_scene s on s.id=v.scene_id and s.deleted_at is null where v.id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
select exists(select 1 from ar_scene where published_version_id=cast(#{id} as uuid))
mapper.insert: insert into ar_audit(scene_id,actor_id,actor_name,action,detail) values(cast(#{sceneId} as uuid),#{actor},#{actorName},#{action},cast(#{detail} as jsonb))
mapper.select: where v.scene_id=cast(#{sceneId} as uuid) order by v.version_no desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from ar_scene_version where scene_id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
select lock_version as "lockVersion",published_version_id::text as "publishedVersionId" from ar_scene where id=cast(#{id} as uuid) and deleted_at is null

select v.id::text as id,v.version_no as "versionNo",v.description, s.published_at as "publishedAt",s.published_by_name as "publishedByName" from ar_scene s join ar_scene_version v on v.id=s.published_version_id where s.id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
select id::text from ar_scene_version where scene_id=cast(#{sceneId} as uuid) and request_key=cast(#{requestKey} as uuid)
select coalesce(max(version_no),0)+1 from ar_scene_version where scene_id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
mapper.insert: insert into ar_scene_version(id,scene_id,version_no,request_key,description,creator_id,creator_name) values(cast(#{id} as uuid),cast(#{sceneId} as uuid),#{versionNo}, cast(#{requestKey} as uuid),#{description},#{actor},#{actorName})
mapper.select: select description=#{description} from ar_scene_version where id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
mapper.update: update ar_scene_version set description=#{description},lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=now() where id=cast(#{id} as uuid) and lock_version=#{expectedVersion}

update ar_scene set published_version_id=cast(#{versionId} as uuid),published_at=now(), published_by_id=#{actor},published_by_name=#{actorName},lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=now() where id=cast(#{sceneId} as uuid) and deleted_at is null and lock_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select exists(select 1 from ar_scene_version where id=cast(#{id} as uuid))
select scene_id::text as "sceneId",request_key::text as "requestKey",version_no as "versionNo",description from ar_scene_version where id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
mapper.delete: delete from ar_scene_version where id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
mapper.select: select s.published_version_id::text from ar_scene s join ar_scene_version v on v.scene_id=s.id where s.id=cast(#{sceneId} as uuid) and v.id=cast(#{versionId} as uuid) and s.enabled and s.deleted_at is null and s.published_version_id is not null
